findings.message: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
Deployz ignores the deployment files in this repository (kubernetes/kustomization.yaml). It builds the Dockerfile and provisions the infrastructure itself.
